description: Presidential Secretariat - Appointments of Ministers and State Ministers
categorisation: This gazette contains both the names of specific individuals (Hon. Susil Premajayantha, Hon. Bandula Gunawardhana, etc.) AND detailed descriptions of their ministerial portfolios and responsibilities (e.g., "Minister of Public Administration, Home Affairs & Justice," "State Minister of International Trade and Investment Promotion"). This combination of naming individuals and specifying their detailed government responsibilities makes it a Hybrid Gazette according to the classification rules.
